meta.description: Opens and closes a cap: every ray bends down along its length until its margin meets the stipe. Connect time to watch a button open, or an age to open old caps further than young ones. Put it after margin_waves and margin_curl, so the closed margin still meets the stipe.

cap.description: The paths of the cap node: the rays of the caps and their stipes

opening.description: 0 = a closed button with the margin against the stipe, 1 = open as the cap was drawn
